name: Beidou
title: Uncrowned Lord of the Ocean
description: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.

skillTalents.name: Oceanborne
skillTalents.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skillTalents.name: Tidecaller
skillTalents.description:
#Nothing to worry about. Should anyone raise a hand against her or her men, she will avenge it ten-fold with sword and thunder.

{LAYOUT_MOBILE#Tap}{LAYOUT_PC#Press}{LAYOUT_PS#Press}
Accumulating the power of lightning, Beidou swings her blade forward fiercely, dealing Electro DMG.

Hold
Lifts her weapon up as a shield. Max DMG absorbed scales off Beidou's Max HP.
Attacks using the energy stored within the greatsword upon release or once this ability's duration expires, dealing Electro DMG. DMG dealt scales with the number of times Beidou is attacked in the skill's duration. The greatest DMG Bonus will be attained once this effect is triggered twice.
The shield possesses the following properties:
·Has 250% Electro DMG Absorption Efficiency.
·Applies the Electro element to Beidou upon activation.

Conquer the high seas! Pursue the waves and chase the storm!

upgrades.name: Additional Tidecaller DMG per power stack — adds to Base DMG, maximum 2 stacks

modifiers.label: Tidecaller only — additional ATK-based damage per power stack (maximum 2)

skillTalents.name: Stormbreaker
skillTalents.description:
Recalling her slaying of the great beast Haishan, Beidou calls upon that monstrous strength and the lightning to create a Thunderbeast's Targe around herself, dealing Electro DMG to nearby opponents.

Thunderbeast's Targe
·When Normal and Charged Attacks hit, they create a lightning discharge that can jump between opponents, dealing Electro DMG.
·Increases the character's resistance to interruption, and decreases DMG taken.

A maximum of 1 lightning discharge can be triggered per second.

With a peal of thunder, Haishan is slain.

modifiers.label: Stormbreaker — incoming damage reduction for the protected active character

passiveTalents.name: Retribution
passiveTalents.description: Counterattacking with Tidecaller at the precise moment when the character is hit grants the maximum DMG Bonus.

passiveTalents.name: Lightning Storm
passiveTalents.description:
Gain the following effects for 10s after unleashing Tidecaller with its maximum DMG Bonus: 
·DMG dealt by Normal and Charged Attacks is increased by 15%. ATK SPD of Normal and Charged Attacks is increased by 15%.
·Greatly reduced delay before unleashing Charged Attacks.

modifiers.label: After maximum Tidecaller — Normal Attack DMG Bonus
After maximum Tidecaller — Normal Attack SPD
After maximum Tidecaller — Charged Attack DMG Bonus
After maximum Tidecaller — Charged Attack SPD

passiveTalents.name: Conqueror of Tides
passiveTalents.description:
Decreases swimming Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

passiveTalents.name: Polaris
passiveTalents.description:
When holding down on the Elemental Skill Tidecaller, 1 stack of power will accumulate every 0.8s, even when not under attack. This increases the DMG dealt at the point of unleashing.
Additionally, holding down to unleash Tidecaller and hitting the opponent also gives extra boosts based on the power accumulated: every stack active decreases Beidou's Elemental Skill CD by 4s, as well as regenerates 8 Elemental Energy for her. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
Additionally, when inside a Polestar Field, Beidou will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state.

constellations.name: Sea Beast's Scourge
constellations.description:
When Stormbreaker is used:
Creates a shield that absorbs up to 16% of Beidou's Max HP for 15s.
This shield absorbs Electro DMG 250% more effectively.

modifiers.label: Stormbreaker C1 shield capacity based on Beidou Max HP

constellations.name: Upon the Turbulent Sea, the Thunder Arises
constellations.description: Stormbreaker's arc lightning can jump to 2 additional targets.

constellations.name: Summoner of Storm
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Tidecaller by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Stunning Revenge
constellations.description:
Upon being attacked, Beidou's Normal Attacks gain an additional instance of 20% Electro DMG for 10s.

Mechanics: The additional instance deals 20% of Beidou's ATK as Electro DMG and can also be triggered by Charged Attack hits. It is not classified as Normal, Charged, Skill or Burst DMG. Being hit can activate this effect even without HP damage.

skills.label: Stunning Revenge — one additional Electro instance triggered by a Normal or Charged hit

constellations.name: Crimson Tidewalker
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Stormbreaker by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Bane of Evil
constellations.description:
During the duration of Stormbreaker, the Electro RES of surrounding opponents is decreased by 15%.

Witch's Revelation — enhanced effect
While Stormbreaker is active, nearby opponents' Electro RES is reduced by 15%.

Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: The Cryo RES of nearby opponents is decreased by 15%, and the Elemental Mastery of the current active character is increased by 200, while Stormbreaker is active.

modifiers.label: During Stormbreaker — nearby opponent Electro RES reduction
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct only, during Stormbreaker — nearby opponent Cryo RES reduction
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct only, during Stormbreaker — active character Elemental Mastery
